panels.title: Today's three tasks
points: (a) 'Young people should spend at least one day a week without screens.' Discuss.
(b) Write a story with the title 'The Last Light'.
(c) Describe a market as it opens at dawn.

keywords.def: keeping quality up for the whole time

questions.q: Plan (5 minutes): five lines, with your targets written at the top
Core (timed, 28 minutes): write your piece in the portal response box
questions.a: Marked with the 4EB1 Section C criteria: AO4 20, AO5 10

questions.q: Extend: edit and proofread (3 minutes) using your error log
Stretch: underline where you applied each target
How should you choose your task?
options: the one I can plan fastest with a clear shape
questions.a: A) the one I can plan fastest with a clear shape. Speed of planning predicts control of the whole piece.
